{{Top|leg}}
A '''hyperspace warping device''' was a type of machine that could be used to transport large groups of individuals to any location in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], via a [[Wormhole/Legends|wormhole]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] hired the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Vylagos]] to build them a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] warping device, which they planned to use to launch an attack on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Vylagos constructed the device inside a Separatist base located on the world [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]], but before the machine could be used by the CIS, the base was attacked by the [[313th Legion]], a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] unit. During the battle, the device was accidentally activated, and it transported the [[Legion/Legends|legion]] and the base's CIS garrison to an unknown world located beyond the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].
